TUMexchange bar comparison

Measured bars share one 100% reference track. Search by university, country, year, or source note, then open a row for its PDF geometry.

A normalized bar score compares raw width with the calibrated full bar under the linear assumption. Assigned 100% rows use the no-applications rule. The score is a bar measurement, not a grade or admission prediction.
